segments.name: life science
segments.description: Discovers, develops and commercializes medicines for rare disorders, including phenylketonuria and Duchenne muscular dystrophy, and sells them globally.
segments.evidence: The Company views its operations and manages its business in one operating segment: life science.

revenueModel.text: Distributors and payers pay PTC Therapeutics for its medicines, with revenue mostly from net product sales plus collaboration and license payments.
revenueModel.evidence: For the year ended December 31, 2025, four of the Company's distributors each accounted for over 10 % of the Company's net product sales.
